name: Hercule Barton
original_name: エルキュール・バートン
source:
A member of "Milky Holmes".

Hercule is a very shy girl who is easily embarrassed. She often tries to be the voice of reason, but her timid nature means she's often ignored and yelled at afterwards. Her Toys gives her superhuman strength. 

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tantei_Opera_Milky_Holmes#Milky_Holmes]Wikipedia[/url]]
